8.3.5 CV2x_ProvideTxBuffer
[CP_SWS_CV2x_01030] Definition of API function CV2x_ProvideTxBuffer
Status: DRAFT
⌈
Service Name
CV2x_ProvideTxBuffer (draft)
Syntax
BufReq_ReturnType CV2x_ProvideTxBuffer (
uint8 CtrlId,
uint8 Priority,
Eth_BufIdxType* BufIdPtr,
uint8** BufPtr,
uint16* LenBytePtr
)
Service ID [hex]
0x05
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Non Reentrant
Parameters (in)
CtrlId
ndex of the controller within the context of the Cellular V2X Driver
▽
△
Priority
Priority value used for selection of different wireless transmit
queues
Parameters (inout)
LenBytePtr
In: desired length in bytes, out: granted length in bytes
BufIdPtr
Index to the granted buffer resource. To be used for subsequent
requests
Parameters (out)
BufPtr
Pointer to the granted buffer
Return value
BufReq_ReturnType
BUFREQ_OK: success BUFREQ_E_NOT_OK: default error detected
BUFREQ_E_BUSY: all buffers in use BUFREQ_E_OVFL: requested
buffer too large
Description
Provides access to a transmit buffer of the specified controller
Tags: atp.Status=draft
Available via
CV2x.h
⌋
[CP_SWS_CV2x_01031]
Status: DRAFT
⌈The function CV2x_ProvideTxBuffer shall provide a transmit buffer resource.⌋
[CP_SWS_CV2x_01100]
Status: DRAFT
⌈The Cellular V2X Driver shall lock the buffer until it receives a subsequent call of
CV2x_Transmit service with the buffer index returned in the BufIdxPtr parameter.⌋
[CP_SWS_CV2x_01032]
Status: DRAFT
⌈All locked transmit buffers shall be released if the controller is disabled via
CV2x_SetControlle

targets.why: Buffer locking mechanism until transmit call
